user.description: Logger's LAN address, `{lan}` — Logger → Settings → Home Assistant shows the one to paste.

data_description.url: The LAN port, 4173. Never the public address: it answers with a sign-in page.

reconfigure.description: A new address for the same Logger (its instance id is checked): `{lan}`.

data_description.url: The LAN port, 4173. Never the public address: it answers with a sign-in page.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect: no Logger answered at this address. Use its LAN address (port 4173) — the public address answers with a sign-in page.
error.invalid_url: Not an http or https address.

abort.already_configured: This Logger (its instance id) is set up already. A new address for it: Reconfigure.
abort.unsupported_api: This Logger speaks API {api}; this integration knows up to {max}. Update the integration in HACS.
abort.wrong_logger: This address answers as another Logger (a different instance id).

data_description.scan_interval: How often Logger is read, in seconds (15–600).
data_description.tz: Decides what “today” is in Logger's answers and writes. Home Assistant's own by default.
data_description.alerts: Read Logger's problems into the Problems sensor.
data_description.voice: Writes Assist's sentences from Logger's words (foods, products, shopping items, lists, symptoms) into Home Assistant's custom sentences, and into Speech-to-Phrase's folder when there is one. Rewritten daily when they change; off removes them.

wrong_logger.message: This address answers as another Logger ({found}). Reconfigure the entry with this Logger's address.

unsupported_api.message: This Logger speaks API {api}; this integration knows up to {max}. Update the integration in HACS.

no_logger.message: No Logger is set up or loaded.

which_logger.message: Several Loggers are set up: name one with config_entry_id.

no_quick_entry.message: Logger has no quick entry “{entry}” (give its id or its exact name).

ambiguous_quick_entry.message: Several quick entries are named “{entry}”: give its id.

fire.name: Fire a quick entry
